summary: This bill requires the FCC to hold annual public hearings after major disaster activations of its Disaster Information Reporting System and issue public reports detailing outages of broadband, VoIP, and mobile services along with impacts on emergency calls, then investigate and recommend rule changes to improve outage notifications to 9-1-1 centers.

scores.thoughts: This bill requires the FCC to investigate and report on emergency communications outages, including 9-1-1 outages, and recommend changes to improve resiliency. This involves increased oversight of communication providers and their services, which falls under the umbrella of tech regulation.
